messages:
Priya (People Ops): Quick heads-up 11 Anya's birthday and 3-year Redwood anniversary is next Thu (May 2). Low-key hybrid surprise planned. Reply A/B/C/D with your pick:
A) Office cupcakes + small desk gift
B) Care packages mailed to remote folks + Zoom toast
C) Small potted plant for her desk + signed card
D) Donate to a charity she cares about + virtual shoutout
Please also volunteer for one task in the signup doc: https://tiny.redwood/anya-celebrate. I can host the Zoom toast at 3:30pm PT. @here

Zoe: A 3 cupcakes sound perfect. I can make gluten-free and label them.

Marcus: B 3 remote here so care packages please. Happy to help pack.

Lena: D 3 love the idea of donating. I can set up the donation page and suggest a few orgs.

Carlos: C 3 succulent or small fern would be nice. I can take care of the card and chip in $10.

Anya: no spoilers!! :pleading_face: (actually i'm terrible at surprises) I'll be OOO that afternoon but can try to pop into the toast.

Priya (People Ops): Noted. We'll keep it quiet for folks who shouldn't know. @PeopleOpsBot could you create the calendar event and Zoom link?

PeopleOpsBot: Event created  "Anya celebration"  May 2  3:30pm PT  Zoom link added  RSVP: 6 so far

Marcus: I'll bring compostable plates and a couple of candles. Any allergies?

Zoe: Tree nuts allergy here. I'll clearly label GF + nut-free cupcakes.

Priya (People Ops): Plan so far: Office cupcakes in SF kitchen + care packages for remote folks. Volunteers: Zoe (GF cupcakes), Carlos (card + $), Marcus (plates/candles/packing help), Lena (donation setup). Need 1 more volunteer for postage/packing. Sign up: https://tiny.redwood/anya-celebrate

Lena: I'll post charity options tomorrow and suggested amounts.

Priya (People Ops): Also thinking of a 30s montage from folks. If you have a short clip or photo with Anya, DM me or drop it here by Tue EOD.

Anya: okay now you're making me nervous, I'll still send a couple of clips. love you all <3

Carlos: Happy to help with postage and check local courier rates.

Zoe: :tada: excited!

Priya (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll drop the final checklist and shopping list by Wednesday. :party-parrot:
